scripts.predev: npm run build -w @attruvi/core && npm run build -w @attruvi/connectors
scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @attruvi/core && npm run build -w @attruvi/connectors
scripts.lint: eslint src packages workers scripts next.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build -w @attruvi/core && npm run build -w @attruvi/connectors && npm run build -w @attruvi/react-native && npm run build -w @attruvi/worker-links && npm run build -w @attruvi/worker-ingest
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:workspaces
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @attruvi/core && npm run build -w @attruvi/connectors
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:schema
scripts.security:check: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:audit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:all
